description: §5.2.3 (S435) — an inline block handler whose FIRST statement is a call runs every statement after it. Carried on impl#1 (P7) under the same defect as the `${…}` form (`expr-handler-call-first-multi-stmt`): every statement after a leading call is dropped.
rationale: §5.2.3 (amended S435): "a statement's effect SHALL NOT depend on whether an earlier statement is a call or an assignment". One click: track sets last to "reset", then count 5 → 0.
